## tl;dr [quarto _splice_](https://github.com/rodrigo-j-goncalves/splice)

Just use it like this:

````markdown
## Slide on the main presentation

Some content

{{{< splice "secondary-presentation.html" >}}}

More content
````
. . .

- Advance through all the slides, without changing anything, without clicking anywhere, whithout worrying about the focus.

. . .

- When the secondary presentation ends, the primary presentation continues.


## What is [quarto splice](https://github.com/rodrigo-j-goncalves/splice)

- You have a `quarto revealjs` presentation, and would like to show an external presentation inside your primary presentation.
- But you don't want to click around to go back and forth with the focus...

[quarto splice](https://github.com/rodrigo-j-goncalves/splice) allows you to include and **play seamlessly** external presentations inside your main presentation.

## Motivation

- I wanted to include [manim-slides](https://manim-slides.eertmans.be/latest/) animations in my quarto revealjs lectures
- But to run the animations I had to activate them first, breaking my workflow
- With [quarto splice](https://github.com/rodrigo-j-goncalves/splice) you can splice several presentations into a single flow of slides.
- You can use it with manim-slides or other HTML-based presentations (revealjs).

## Example 1: a `manim-slides` animation

A spacecraft animation exported from `manim-slides` as a single HTML file.

Keep pressing `→`  (no clicks needed, no focus issues).

{{< splice "splice-these/nave.html" >}}

## Your lecture continues here

After the animation ends, the primary presentation resumes automatically.

Add as many intermediate slides as you need between animations.
